out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS emailed CFM copy of employee health policy and review information with food employees, sign the document, and maintain on file for future reference.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers (open coffee no lid/ straw and open bottle of water) stored in a manner that may contaminate food (near raw chicken being prepped) on food prep counter.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: CFM relocated the open coffee cup and open bottle of water to an area away from the food prep area. VIET AROMA ASIAN CUISINE (Inspection Date: 08/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:cut lettuce (60F) stored inside the 2 Dr preptop refrigerator in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated the cut lettuce to the walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F or below.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials (Lysol wipes) are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food (on prep counter near raw chicken being prepped). Bottle of hand sanitizer stored above packages of dry seaweed on dry shelf near kitchen entrance door.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI: CFM relocated Lysol wipes and bottle of hand sanitizer to storage area away from food, food contact surfaces, and single service items.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: dry spices and seasonings (star of anise, fennel, salt, sugar, etc) on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to label all food items removed from the original container and not easily identifiable.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 Dr preptop refrigerator ambient temperature at time of inspection 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS instructed CFM to lower manually turn 2 Dr preptop refrigerator down to ambient temperature of 41F or below or schedule repair.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises throughout the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. EHS instructed CFM to began the process of removing unnecessary/ unused equipment from the kitchen area.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing (employee’s purse and bookbag) stored in areas that may contaminate food (dry food) stored on dry food shelf in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: CFM relocated employees’ purse and bookbag to designated area away from food.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS texted CFM copy of written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the end of the cookline in the kitchen being used to store multiple food items.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: CFM removed food items from sink basin.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Food containers observed stored on floors inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: exterior surfaces of cooking equipment including the microwave oven are in need of cleaning. Surfaces of prep tables, ware washing machine exterior, piping under The 3-vat sink, are in need of cleaning,
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Maintain surfaces of tables, equipment, piping, in clean condition at all times. Clean these surfaces more often to prevent debris build-up.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the dolor under cooking equipment, refrigerators , prep tables, under thge 3-vat skin, is in need of cleaning. The floor detains azure also in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 50 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the food preparation areas. The lighting in the kitchen is inadequate. Several builbs in the ceiling light fixtures above the prep areas have burned out.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 50 foot candles in all food preparation areas. Replace the burned out ceiling light bulbs to provide proper iliumination in the kitchen.
